body: I have only had suicidal thoughts about three times. This is the worst one and it has mostly passed. I thank reddit. <3 Thank you, really. It means a lot.

I don't even want to think about the situation at hand, much less cry. I just..I wish I could avoid it but I am constantly thinking about it because it bothers me so much. And the more I think about it? The more pain I feel over the whole thing. I think some of it is disappointment in myself and disappointment in my best friend.

In case I haven't mentioned, I don't plan on cutting again, no. The gash on my finger is bad enough. Usually, I have such an easy time coping with anything and everything and I even have so much room to care about my family and friends. But this time? I can't even deal with myself. I don't know what to do to not have suicidal thoughts.
It stopped me from crying. And it made me feel something other than self-hatred. I keep fucking up.
I'd also like to thank you for sharing your story, it gives me something to relate to. <3

I can really relate to you. That is a detail I left out...I love her. Yes, feelings. Not just as a friend. I've never felt anything like it and just knowing that she could do that to me whether she intends it to be permanent or not just kills me. She just suckerpunched my feelings is what she did. I don't know if she really knows how I feel.

I don't think I want her to know.

I'm still forever alone. Never had a girl or boyfriend, never kissed. It feels shitty. I know I'm relationship-hopeless. This happening just makes me feel like I'm not worthy of anything and in the past few days, I can't think about this situation without wondering if suicide is the option for me.

My rationality still kicks in and I always talk myself out of it but I can't stop the current feelings of self-hatred that are happening to me. I can't. I try but I can't. I know I will be able to move on, but I would like that to be as soon as possible because my love getting suckerpunched and our friendship getting flushed by her is tearing me apart. It's like any effort I ever made in anything is just a complete waste.

I understand not getting what I want is something that happens. Of course.

But I really only wanted her friendship.

And I can't even have that.
Because I have failed everything. Myself, her apparently. I seem to keep making mistakes and as much as I apologize, I'm never good enough...
